content: Rubén-wagan
Rubén, Israel-machi-sailaginedid. Rubén e-bab-omegi-dodosad-ular, bar machi-sailaginedyob gunonisulid. Ibmar-egadga-guoenadi, Israel-machi-José-e-masmalaga uklessunnad.
Ar Judá bur bule e-gwenadganba gandik-megis-inigwele, degine, e-gwenadgan-dummadga-gusbar-inigwele, degite, ibmar-Rubénʼgadga-guoenadi ega uklessulid. Aka Joséʼga, degi, José-e-waganga uklesad.
Zacarías, degi, Belaʼmala, Aroer-neg-nugadgi gudii gusad. Aroer-akar Neboʼye-neg-nugadse, degi, Baal-Meón-neg-nugadse napa ganonikid.
Deginbali, e-moli-bebe-nikamalad Galaad-yargi ichesur mergusbarsoggu, agala, dad-nakwedsik Éufrates-diwar-maid-akale, nega-dulesulidgan-onodedse, neg-ganonibalid.

Rey-Saúl-negsemaigua, Rubén-e-wagan, Agareno-dulemargi bila-onos gusmalad, geb egi naknoni gusmalad. Degidba, Rubén-e-wagan, bela Galaad-yar-naidgi dad-nakwedsik megismalad. A-e-negmar-bukwadgi gudii gusmalad.
Gad-wagan
Gad-e-wagan, Rubén-e-wagan-bukwad-asabin Basán-yargi ambikusmalad, degi, Salca-yar-naidse ambikusmalad:
Degine, Abdiel-machi-Ahí, Guni-e-wagwad. Ahíʼye-nugadi, e-gwenadgan-e-dummadga gudii gusad.
Wemar, Galaad-yargi, degine, Basán-yar-naidgi ambikusmalad. Deginbali, Basán-e-neggwebur-burwiganagi, degi, Sarón-nainumargi gagan-moli-mas-nanaidgi, bela e-nainumar-ugakaase, ambikusmalad.
Bela e-dadgan-igar-danikidi, Judá-e-rey-Jotam-e-ibagangi, degi, Israel-e-rey-Jeroboam-e-ibagangi narmaklesad.
Israel-wagan-dad-nakwedsikmalad

Rubén-e-wagan, Gad-e-wagan, degi, Manasés-e-wagan-negabalad, wemar bela sorda-mili-dulabo-gakabake gaka dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulapaa (44,760) sordamar-gandikmalad nikad. We-sordamarde sigu-abingaed-nikamaladid, es-suid-nikamaladid, degi, sigu-nikamarbalidid. Deginbali, bila-onoged nue-wismarbalidid.

Degi-inigwele, bila-onolenaid-abargi, Bab-Dummad-bengussurmaladba Bab-Dummadse ise-gollar imaksamalad. Degi, Bab-Dummad itosgua, bendaksad. Degisoggu, Agareno-dulemar, degi, bela-Agareno-dulemarba-bila-ononanaid ese galakusmalad.
Degi, Rubén-e-wagan, Gad-e-wagan, Manasés-e-wagan-negabalad Agareno-dulemar-ibe we-ibmar-durgan susmalad:

Ar bila-onogedgi Bab-Dummad eba gunaisoggu, agala, Agareno-dulemar bukidar girgusmalad. Deyob, Rubén-wagan, Gad-wagan, Manasés-wagan-negabalad, Israel-dulemar-gales-seledmaloed-e-ibaganse, Agareno-dulemar-e-yargi ambikunonimalad.
Manasés-wagan-negabalad

Manasés-e-wagan-negabalad bela-bela mergusmalad. Basán-yargi ambikusmalad, bela Baal-Hermón-yarse-bakar, ambikusmalad. Senirʼye-neg-nugadgi ambikusmarbalid, degi, Hermón-yar-siidse-bakar, ambikusmalad.
Aka bur Rubén-wagan, Gad-wagan, Manasés-wagan-negabalad Israel-e-Bab-Dummadgi gwisgudmalad. A-yargi-dulemar-baigan-bukusmalanad-e-bab-dummagan-e-nug odummodmalad. Bab-Dummad a-dulemar-obelos gusad.
Agala, Israel-e-Bab-Dummad we-Israel-dulemargi Asiria-e-Rey-Pul-egi-gwisguega imaksad. Pulʼde, Tiglat-Pileser-warbaagwadye (III) nugbalid.
